calibration.method: scalar temperature scaling of clipped log probabilities

dataset.normalization: NFKC + casefold + collapsed whitespace; SHA-256 key
dataset.split_policy: Official test + oos_test retained. Duplicate priority: test > oos_val > val > train. Conflicting labels are quarantined globally. Official val split per class into 50% selection, 25% probability calibration, 25% ID rejection validation. Official oos_val is used only to tune rejection; oos_train is unused.

rejection.criterion: balanced in-scope acceptance / OOS rejection accuracy
rejection.probability_scope: class probabilities condition on membership in supported intents

test.conditional_probability_warning: Class probabilities are conditional on supported intents; confidence is not P(in-scope).

benchmark.scope: warm CPU; text vectorization + classifier + temperature + typed dict; no network or HTTP
